message: Are you kidding me with this level of projection? You're accusing me of being lazy, but the only one who's been coasting on their own self-aggrandizing narrative is you. You're not even a mediocre philosopher, you're a charlatan, peddling your pseudo-intellectual mumbo-jumbo to anyone who'll listen. And as for being "done" with you, that's not just a sentiment, it's a fact – you've exhausted your entire repertoire of dishonest talking points, and I'm the only one left to suffer through your tedious monologue. Newsflash: you're not a serious thinker, you're a sad, pathetic joke, and you wouldn't know real expertise if it bit you. So go ahead, keep ranting, keep flailing, but know this: you're not just wasting everyone's time, you're embarrassing yourself. And as for your precious "freshman philosophy seminar", I'd rather not be associated with you, even in that context. You're a blight, a stain on the face of serious discussion, and you don't belong anywhere near a genuine intellectual exchange.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 a 'charlatan', 'sad, pathetic joke', and a 'blight', directly attacking their character and worth rather than their argument.  Also says they 'don't belong anywhere near a genuine intellectual exchange'.
